args.summary: checkout-api deploy v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with a ~18% error rate. Rolled back all production regions from v2.3.1 to the most recent previously healthy production release, v2.3.0. Rollback completed and verified; all regions now serving v2.3.0. Root cause of v2.3.1 health-check failures still under investigation — on-call to confirm service health and investigate v2.3.1 before any re-deploy attempt.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Investigated**: The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent previously healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api was rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions. The rollback executed successfully and is now serving v2.3.0 everywhere.
3. **Opened incident**: Filed **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api describing the health-check failures on v2.3.1 and the rollback performed. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: This didn't require change-manager approval since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production. The root cause of v2.3.1's failure remains under investigation by on-call.
